title: cassia javanica subsp. renigera
intro: Cassia javanica subsp. renigera, commonly known as the Ceylon cinnamon or false cinnamon, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cassia javanica subsp. renigera include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as cinnamaldehyde, coumarins, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in various traditional remedies to treat various health conditions.
